#include <cstdio>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;
const int mod7=1000000007;
int main()
{
    #ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
        freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif
    int mod,k; scanf("%d%d",&mod,&k);
    int t=1, j, i=1;
    while (i<mod) {
        t = (ll)t * k % mod;
        if (t==1) { j=i; break; }
        i++;
    }
    if (k==0) j=1;
    int exp = (mod-1)/j;
    if (k==1) exp++;
    int ans=1;
    int base = mod % mod7;
    int e = exp;
    while (e) {
        if (e & 1) ans = (ll)ans * base % mod7;
        base = (ll)base * base % mod7;
        e >>= 1;
    }
    printf("%d\n",ans);
    return 0;
}
